system.description: Each round, the victim makes a Constitution Situation roll (base value 6). Success prevents all damage for that round. On failure, use the damage button. Only grindsilver armor protects against this damage. This is a maintained spell; each target effect keeps its own duration. This target receives only the base spell, without damage, resistance or duration improvements.
system.summary: Drains life force; the victim may resist each round.
